summary: Gone steel lookout on Bald Mountain at the Nelson-Augusta line; removed in the 1970s, footers left by 2018, and sources disagree on whether it was built in the 1930s or 1960s.

facts.status_note: Removed in the 1970s; only concrete footers remained as of 2018

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS gives early 1960s in its Built field but says late 1930s in its description; a 1957 Coast and Geodetic Survey note already describes a lookout tower on the peak. The story gives the dates as the sources state them and does not choose one.
The Nelson record names the Virginia Department of Forestry; the Augusta record for the same coordinates names the U.S. Forest Service. Both are reported.
A 1932 report planned a 50-foot tower; the Augusta record gives 60 feet. No height is recorded in facts for this reason.

notes_for_editor: The Nelson record's Built field and description disagree (early 1960s vs late 1930s), and the 1957 survey note supports an earlier date; the editor may want the original FFLOS build year. FFLOS US 1725 (Augusta County, same coordinates) is a separate record for the same peak; consider merging or cross-linking. Access is unverified: a Facebook group post in search results says the land around Bald Mountain is owned by Molpus Timberlands and visitation to the tower site is allowed, but the page was login-walled and only one line was readable, so it is not used. Nelson's Cottages result is about Rondaxe Mountain in New York and was ignored. Brief record: no build year was recorded, and the agency matches the Nelson record.
